summary: Writer spaces and structured list Paste match the bounded upstream ownership model and pass all repository gates.
findings: Clipboard HTML is sanitized into canonical paragraphs and list metadata, inserted through one compound Writer undo action; Space is normalized at the accelerator boundary and repeated whitespace is preserved only in presentation.
evidence_refs: npm run verify: 210 runtime tests and 79 inventory tests at 100% coverage; 9 Chromium E2E tests passed
hidden_assumptions: Clipboard structure support is intentionally bounded to semantic p, div, ol, ul, and li elements plus existing direct-format tags.
residual_risks: Arbitrary office-suite-specific clipboard CSS and proprietary HTML are outside the approved Stage 4 slice.
